digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation freshness and manifest signing
propositions: A ticket declaring file_impact_scope: none should retain a valid certified attestation after an unrelated HEAD commit, without re-hashing dependencies or applying whole-HEAD freshness drift checks.

Empty dependency maps paired with explicit own_scope: none must classify as none and emit exactly one signed file-scope: none manifest declaration, while legacy undeclared empty impacts classify as unscoped and fall back to whole-HEAD stale-head behavior.
A none-scoped manifest declaration present only in unauthenticated plaintext cannot suppress stale-head validity; the authenticated signed manifest alone determines scope.

Changing only no_file_impact_reason or flipping scope between none and paths must invalidate a signed attestation as stale-material, triggered through canonical JSON basis member additions to the material fingerprint.

The resign_plan_review recovery path must preserve none scope through the same sign_plan_review signing boundary without new branches, and old readers must treat absent file-scope declarations as unscoped.

Code changes to attest.py, manifest.py, and pass1.py must preserve the existing 800-line module cap and pass all lint, typecheck, and behavior-contract test gates without source-inspection assertions.
